customers_say: Customers find the door lock's appearance appealing and appreciate its solid build quality, convenient keyless entry, and multiple access options. The installation process is smooth, and they consider it good value for money. However, the functionality receives mixed feedback, with some reporting issues with the front lock not working. Moreover, connectivity is a concern, with several customers noting no WiFi connectivity.

reviews.author: Kanraj Jain
reviews.title: Good Features, but Fingerprint Sensitivity Needs Improvement
reviews.body: The Qubo Smart Lock offers great functionality overall—keyless entry works seamlessly, and the mobile app integration is smooth. Installation was fairly straightforward, and the build quality feels solid and premium. However, one major drawback I faced was while trying to register fingerprints. It consistently failed to recognize or register my wife’s fingerprint, no matter how many times we tried.
